item.title: Version 1.3.98
item.description:
- Sidebar cut from 11 items to 5 you use daily (Portfolio, Galleries, Homepage, Publish Site, Settings) plus a collapsible **More** group that opens by itself when you land on a page inside it.
- New hand-built pixel-art icon set for every section, tinted by the photo-driven accent with a glow on the selected one.
- Leftover flat greens (selected rows, drop zones, step badges, highlights) now follow the photo accent. Status colours such as Live, Ready and passed stay green.
- Motion: pages cross-fade when you switch sections, gallery cards spring in one after another, and the accent colour fades between photos instead of snapping.
- Publishing success now plays a burst of rings and pixel sparks, and an "Open site" button appears on the console.
- basiciggy.com/tools gets an **Apps** section with cards for One Less Thing and BasicWatch, plus Apps in the quick-nav dock and the Extras menu.
